name: Minshina's Skull
summary: On the Echo Isles, Minshina's soul remains bound to his skull by Zalazane's dark magic. Minshina was a Darkspear troll and Master Gadrin's brother. Zalazane seized the isles and drove the tribe away, then used Minshina's skull in his rituals.

sections.title: A Trapped Spirit
sections.body:
Minshina was captured and slain when Zalazane seized the Echo Isles and drove out the Darkspear. The traitorous witch doctor bound his soul to his severed skull instead of letting him pass into death. Now the skull lies within a circle of power on the southernmost isle, holding Minshina fast to Zalazane's magic.

Master Gadrin dreams of his brother calling to him, and seeks brave travelers to enter the occupied islands. He asks them to reclaim the skull and break Zalazane's hold over Minshina's spirit.

faq.answer: Minshina was a Darkspear troll and the brother of Master Gadrin of Sen'jin Village. Zalazane murdered him amid his betrayal on the Echo Isles.

faq.q: Why is Minshina's soul trapped in his skull?
faq.answer: Zalazane used dark magic to bind Minshina's spirit inside his severed head. He placed the skull in a circle of power on the main isle, keeping Minshina bound to his will instead of passing to the ancestors.
The skull lies on the largest and southernmost isle of the Echo Isles. It rests atop a hill in a circle of power, among candles, ritual markers and other skulls, guarded by Zalazane's thralls.

faq.q: What happens when the skull is brought to Master Gadrin?
faq.answer: When you return the skull to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village, the dark enchantment breaks. Minshina's spectral form appears briefly, bows in gratitude and departs peacefully for the realm of the ancestors.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, Zalazane's desecration of Minshina breaks ancestral tradition. Recovering his skull is a matter of tribal honor.
Recovering the skull strikes an early blow against Zalazane's hold over the Echo Isles, just off Durotar's coast.
